newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary forint eases some 30 pips vs c.bank basket.
newsitem.headline: Hungary forint eases some 30 pips vs c.bank basket.

text.p: Hungarian forint eased some 30 basis points within the central bank's intervention range on Monday, possibly suffering from the currency turmoil in the Czech Republic, dealers said.
The forint opened at 180.90/181.10 to the dollar, compared with Friday's closing of 181.30/35. At 0800 GMT the forint stood at 181.00.

Dealers said the forint firmed on the mark's weekend gains against the dollar, but some foreign currency buying on a slow market widened the gap from the central bank resistance level (NBH bid) to 50 fillers from Friday's closing 20 fillers.
"A bank is buying foreign currencies aggressively," said Peter Luczo of Inter-Europa Bank.
However, traders said the forint was unlikely to move further down within the NBH's 4.5 percent wide floating intervention band.
"Investors begin to buy forints at such a low levels," Luvzo said.
"If the turnover is as low as now and the dollar/mark does not move much, we can go back to levels of 10 to 20 pips from the NBh bid," said Endrodi.
